There seemed to be a good deal of animals that were not available. The ones that came to mind were mouse,bear,sloth,vulcher. It was also not clear when to use a generic name versus a more specific name (i.e., dog versus husky, bird versus crow). I also was not sure if two word animal names were not allowed or if they should be combined with a dash or some other scheme (i.e., blue jay -> bluejay/blue-jay). It was pretty easy to work around the uncertainties, but I think I could have scored higher with a more technical description of the name rules. Anyways, good job with the game. It felt pretty original and kept my attention well. Good luck with the research!
